rationale: Build on the current best rank-64 bigram projection-tail path by using the remaining artifact headroom for a slightly larger rank-80 previous-token residual head. The current script only keeps those factors trainable and fp16-preserved while they are at or below the old 65,536-element threshold; once rank grows past that boundary they would otherwise fall out of Adam and into int8 export. This patch makes all non-block trainable tensors stay on the Adam path and explicitly keeps the bigram factors in fp16, so the extra bigram capacity actually survives training and final roundtrip evaluation.
title: Bigram Rank 80 With Explicit FP16 Tail
